subject: One woman has told the ABC she may have never left her abusive former partner if she had not been able to secure a safe home for her dog.
posts: Safe havens for pets are breaking the chains of domestic abuse, proving that compassion for animals is a vital lifeline for human survivors. Evidence: Legal reform, pet safety, victim empowerment. #Aletheia #DomesticViolence
